mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_run( run_id, corpus_id, app_commit, prompt_version, prompt_hash, embedding_model, llm_model, retrieval_config, dictionary_version, status, error_summary, started_at, finished_at, created_at ) VALUES( #{runId}, #{corpusId}, #{appCommit}, #{promptVersion}, #{promptHash}, #{embeddingModel}, #{llmModel}, #{retrievalConfig}, #{dictionaryVersion}, #{status}, #{errorSummary}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, corpus_id, app_commit, prompt_version, prompt_hash, embedding_model, llm_model, retrieval_config, dictionary_version, status, error_summary, started_at, finished_at, created_at FROM eval_run WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_case_run( eval_run_id, case_pk_id, query_text, status, started_at, finished_at, created_at ) VALUES( #{evalRunId}, #{casePkId}, #{queryText}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_case_run SET actual_intent = #{actualIntent}, actual_anchors = #{actualAnchors}, actual_output_level = #{actualOutputLevel}, actual_degradation_reasons = #{actualDegradationReasons}, response_text = #{responseText}, analysis = #{analysis}, recommendation = #{recommendation}, risks = #{risks}, citations = #{citations}, evidence_quality = #{evidenceQuality}, intent_match = #{intentMatch}, anchor_match = #{anchorMatch}, output_level_match = #{outputLevelMatch}, degradation_reason_match = #{degradationReasonMatch}, reference_context_hit = #{referenceContextHit}, forbidden_context_hit = #{forbiddenContextHit}, forbidden_claim_hit = #{forbiddenClaimHit}, evidence_quality_match = #{evidenceQualityMatch}, needs_manual_review = #{needsManualReview}, auto_scores = #{autoScores}, manual_review_status = #{manualReviewStatus}, status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, eval_run_id, case_pk_id, query_text, actual_intent, actual_anchors, actual_output_level, actual_degradation_reasons, response_text, analysis, recommendation, risks, citations, evidence_quality, intent_match, anchor_match, output_level_match, degradation_reason_match, reference_context_hit, forbidden_context_hit, forbidden_claim_hit, evidence_quality_match, needs_manual_review, auto_scores, manual_review_status, status, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at FROM eval_case_run WHERE eval_run_id = #{evalRunId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_retrieved_context( case_run_id, stage, rank_no, report_id, chunk_uid, parent_chunk_uid, section_path, score, relevance_score, context_type, diagnostic_only, truncated, hit_count, retrieved_text, metadata_json, manual_relevance_level, manual_issue_notes, manual_suggested_action, created_at ) VALUES( #{caseRunId}, #{stage}, #{rankNo}, #{reportId}, #{chunkUid}, #{parentChunkUid}, #{sectionPath}, #{score}, #{relevanceScore}, #{contextType}, #{diagnosticOnly}, #{truncated}, #{hitCount}, #{retrievedText}, #{metadataJson}, #{manualRelevanceLevel}, #{manualIssueNotes}, #{manualSuggestedAction}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, case_run_id, stage, rank_no, report_id, chunk_uid, parent_chunk_uid, section_path, score, relevance_score, context_type, diagnostic_only, truncated, hit_count, retrieved_text, metadata_json, manual_relevance_level, manual_issue_notes, manual_suggested_action, created_at FROM eval_retrieved_context WHERE case_run_id = #{caseRunId} ORDER BY stage ASC, rank_no ASC, id ASC
